responsibility: This header provides the macro framework used to describe GCC target hooks in target.def and related generated hook-definition files. It defines helper defaults for DEFHOOK/DEFHOOKPOD-based table construction, vector nesting macros for building the gcc_target structure and substructures, and the documentation conventions that distinguish documented, undocumented, and shared-documentation hook entries, serving as the metaprogramming glue behind target hook declaration, initialization, and documentation generation.
